dialog.title: Import file
dialog.description: CAMT.053, OFX, QFX and QIF statements are read as they are. Any CSV export with a date and an amount works too; you choose what each column means. Next, you check the result. Nothing is saved before you import.

dropZone.title: Drop a file here or <choose>choose a file</choose>
dropZone.hint: CSV, CAMT.053, OFX, QFX or QIF, up to {megabytes, number} MB

page.imported: {count, plural, one {# transaction imported} other {# transactions imported}}
page.updated: {count, plural, one {# existing booking updated from the file.} other {# existing bookings updated from the file.}}
page.undecided: {count, plural, one {# possible duplicate was left out} other {# possible duplicates were left out}} because the booking chosen for the update changed or was taken by another row.
page.importedHint: Rules categorized the rows without a chosen category. Importing the same file again updates the bookings it already holds from the file.
page.hint: CAMT.053, OFX, QFX and QIF statements are read as they are. Any CSV export with a date and an amount works too: bank exports, Buxfer, spreadsheets; files matching a template, such as Buxfer exports, are mapped automatically, others you map column by column. You check the result, then import. Nothing is saved before you import.
page.leaveQuestion: The import has not finished. Leave anyway? Rows saved so far stay imported.

file.statementRows: {format} statement · {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
file.tooLarge: The file cannot exceed {megabytes, number} MB.
file.unreadable: The file could not be read.

templateNotice.appliedWithChoices: Format, column roles and remembered account and category choices are applied.
templateNotice.applied: Format and column roles are applied.
templateNotice.replaces: Applying it replaces the current format and column roles.

templates.heading: Templates
templates.hint: A file whose header row matches a template is mapped with it automatically; your templates come before built-in ones.
templates.name: Template name
templates.remembered: {count, plural, one {# remembered choice} other {# remembered choices}}

saveTemplate.saved: Saved as template “{name}”. Files with the same columns use it automatically.
saveTemplate.saveHeading: Save this mapping as a template?
saveTemplate.updateHint: Later files with these columns use the format, column roles and choices of this import.
saveTemplate.saveHint: Later files with the same columns are recognized and mapped the same way.
saveTemplate.name: Template name
saveTemplate.remember: Remember the chosen existing accounts and categories

typeChoices.heading: Types
typeChoices.hint: Each value of the type column imports its rows as the chosen type. An expense with a positive amount is a refund that reduces spending. Values set to follow the amount import positive amounts as income and negative ones as expenses. Rules and your corrections still change types later.

categoryChoices.heading: Categories
categoryChoices.hint: Each value without a category of the same name goes to an existing category, a new one created when you import, or stays uncategorized so rules can categorize it. Values with several tags are not guessed; tags with amounts split their row, and each tag is listed here.

targets.statementHint: Each account in the statement goes to an existing account, a new manual account, or is skipped.
targets.fileHint: Each account value in the file goes to an existing account, a new manual account, or is skipped.
targets.mapFirst: Choose the date, amount and payee or description columns below to see the accounts.
targets.accountsFailed: Your accounts could not be loaded
targets.linkedHint: Rows imported into a bank-linked account dated before its opening balance extend its history without changing its balance; later rows change the balance and show up as a difference to the bank balance.
targets.startBalance: Balance at the start of the file
targets.currentBalanceHint: The difference to the imported rows is booked as an opening balance on the file's first date. Leave empty to start from zero.
targets.startBalanceHint: Booked as the opening balance on the file's first date. Leave empty to start from zero.

columns.heading: Columns
columns.reviewHint: {count, plural, one {# row needs attention} other {# rows need attention}}.
columns.reviewHintTruncated: {count, plural, one {# row needs attention} other {# rows need attention}}; the first {shown, number} are shown.
columns.hint: Choose what each column means. Columns you leave on Ignore are not imported.
columns.showingFirst: Showing the first {shown, number} of {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}.
columns.showingFirstSkipped: Showing the first {shown, number} of {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}. Rows of skipped accounts are dimmed.
columns.existingBooking: Matches a booking already in Ufer; it updates that booking unless you decide otherwise under Rows.
columns.possibleDuplicate: Possible duplicate of a booking already in Ufer. Decide under Rows whether it updates, skips or creates a booking.

summary.heading: Import summary
summary.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row of skipped accounts is left out.} other {# rows of skipped accounts are left out.}}
summary.decideFirst: Decide what {count, plural, one {the possible duplicate does} other {the # possible duplicates do}} under Rows before importing.
summary.check: Check {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}

review.heading: Rows
review.hint: Updates write the file's payee, description and type to the booking in Ufer; your own edits, categories, type corrections, splits and links stay. Possible duplicates need a decision.
review.unchanged: {count, plural, one {# matched row changes nothing and is not listed.} other {# matched rows change nothing and are not listed.}}
review.group: {group, select, undecided {Possible duplicates} updates {Updates} new {New} other {Errors}} ({count, number})
review.decideAll: Decide for all {group, select, undecided {possible duplicates} other {updates}}
review.conflictTitle: Another row already updates this booking. Choose another booking or decision.
review.bookingFor: Booking in Ufer for row {line, number}

mapping.text: Map a payee or description column.
